speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Wai3, haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 zau6 dung1 zi3 laa3!/

speaker: 小紅
source_cantonese: 係呀!你屋企會唔會食湯圓呀?
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Hai6 aa3! Nei5 uk1 kei2 wui5 m4 wui5 sik6 tong1 jyun4 aa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 zing2 gaa3./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Zi6 gei2 zing2 ding6 maai5 gaa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Zi6 gei2 zing2 aa3! Hou2 waan2 hou2 do1!/

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Ngo5 mei6 si3 gwo3 zing2 wo3./

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: M4 naan4 gaa3! Ngo5 gaau3 nei5!/

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Zan1 gaa3? Gam3 hou2 aa3!/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Jiu3 maai5 no6 mai5 fan2, zung6 jau5 tong4./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Hai6 mai6 jung6 seoi2 kau1?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Hai6 aa3, jiu3 nyun5 seoi2./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Dim2 gaai2 jiu3 nyun5 seoi2 aa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Nyun5 seoi2 co1 dak1 hou2 di1./

speaker: 小紅
source_cantonese: 搓到好似耳仔咁軟就得喇。
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Co1 dou3 hou2 ci5 ji5 zai2 gam3 jyun5 zau6 dak1 laa3./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Ji5 zai2 gam3 jyun5? Hou2 dak1 ji3!/

speaker: 小紅
source_cantonese: 哈哈,係呀!然後搓成粒粒。
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Haa1 haa1, hai6 aa3! Jin4 hau6 co1 sing4 nap1 nap1./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Jiu3 zing2 gei2 daai6 nap1 aa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Hou2 ci5 bo1 zi2 gam3 daai6 zau6 dak1./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Baau1 m4 baau1 haam6 gaa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Ho2 ji5 baau1, dou1 ho2 ji5 m4 baau1./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Baau1 me1 haam6 hou2 aa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Faa1 sang1, zi1 maa4, dau6 saa1 dou1 dak1./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Ngo5 zung1 ji3 zi1 maa4!/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Hou2 aa3! Gam2 ngo5 dei6 zing2 zi1 maa4 ge3./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Jiu3 bou1 gei2 noi6 aa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: M4 sai2 noi6, ng5 fan1 zung1 zo2 jau6./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Dim2 zi1 suk6 zo2 mei6 aa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Fau4 hei2 zau6 suk6 laa3!/

speaker: 小紅
source_cantonese: 係呀!放啲糖水就食得喇。
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Hai6 aa3! Fong3 di1 tong4 seoi2 zau6 sik6 dak1 laa3./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Dung1 zi3 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 sik6 tong1 jyun4 gaa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Doi6 biu2 jat1 gaa1 tyun4 jyun4./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: O4, hou2 jau5 ji3 si1!/

speaker: 小紅
source_cantonese: 仲有,湯圓係圓嘅,好意頭。
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Zung6 jau5, tong1 jyun4 hai6 jyun4 ge3, hou2 ji3 tau4./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Jyun4 doi6 biu2 tyun4 jyun4, ngaam1 laa3!/

speaker: 小紅
source_cantonese: 冬至係一年最長嘅夜晚。
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Dung1 zi3 hai6 jat1 nin4 zeoi3 coeng4 ge3 je6 maan5./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: So2 ji5 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zeoi6 maai4?/

speaker: 小紅
source_cantonese: 係呀!同屋企人食飯最緊要。
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Hai6 aa3! Tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 sik6 faan6 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Ngo5 dei6 gei2 si4 jat1 cai4 zing2 aa3?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Dung1 zi3 cin4 jat1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1?/

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Dak1 aa3! Ngo5 lai4 nei5 uk1 kei2?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Hou2 aa3! Haa6 zau3 saam1 dim2 dak1 m4 dak1?/

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Mou5 man6 tai4! Ngo5 daai3 di1 je5 lai4?/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: M4 sai2 aa3, ngo5 maai5 saai3 laa3./

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Gam2 ngo5 daai3 jam2 ban2 laa1!/

speaker: 阿明
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Ming4: Jat1 cai4 zing2 tong1 jyun4, hou2 kei4 doi6!/

speaker: 小紅
source_jyutping: /Siu2 Hung4: Ngo5 dou1 hai6! Dou3 si4 gin3!/
